title: Harden Ready cross-app timer continuity and regression harness
prompt:
P0 continuity/regression task. Start from the current Ready isolated branch after any earlier queued foundation task. Preserve all unrelated visual/character/planner work. The user's repeated hard requirement is that Ready execution must not stall, reset, delay incorrectly or lose state when the phone locks, Safari/PWA backgrounds, another app opens, Hide/Snap is called, recording occurs, network is unavailable, or the page returns via BFCache/pageshow. Implement/harden runtime continuity and automated regression coverage without claiming native lock-screen UI that a pure PWA cannot provide.

Hard session locks: ONE SESSION / ONE TARGET TIME / MULTIPLE TASKS / ONE ACTIVE TASK / ONE ACTIVE LAP. Ready is the single top-level session-state owner. TASK_CHANGE = current lap end + next lap start. APP_SWITCH != PAUSE, APP_SWITCH != LAP_END, APP_SWITCH != SESSION_END. SESSION_END != TASK_COMPLETE. Task states include COMPLETED/PARTIAL/DEFERRED/BLOCKED/WAITING_FOR_PARENT.

Timer authority must be timestamp-derived; setInterval/requestAnimationFrame are display refresh only. Audit current ready-runtime-v07 and cross-app routing. Ensure persisted/restorable state includes the minimum needed to recover session_id, goal_id, task_id, lap_id, started_at/target or equivalent, accumulated explicit pause duration, active task/lap, active app/return target and issue/wait state. Return to Ready must restore the same session/lap/task and immediately recompute displayed time from timestamps. Never require a second Start button after ordinary app/background return. Avoid duplicate session creation or target/startAt reset.

Handle distinctly: explicit Pause; ISSUE/real interruption; Recording as learning execution where applicable; System Wait for AI/server/file/network delay. App switch alone is none of these. System wait must not become child ISSUE or inflate attributable Focus time. Network outage must not block local Timer/Core execution. Safe update must not force reload during active session.

Cross-app handoff: Ready -> Hide -> Ready and Ready -> Snap -> Ready must preserve session/goal/task/lap/timing context and trusted return target through existing test override routing. Specialist apps must not be allowed to close the whole Ready session. Add validation around malformed/stale return payloads so recovery prefers the latest valid local Ready snapshot rather than creating a new session.

Lifecycle/recovery to cover: visibilitychange/pagehide/pageshow, BFCache, screen lock/unlock as represented by background/resume events, ordinary external app switch, safe reload/relaunch from local snapshot where platform permits, offline/reconnect. Avoid busy retry loops or artificial delays. UI should render restored state immediately from local snapshot and let network sync follow asynchronously.

Lock-screen split: A) timer continuity while locked is runtime-hard; B) timer visible on iOS lock screen is a preserved requirement but NOT implementable as a fake PWA feature. Add a small architecture/ADR note or bridge interface placeholder only if useful, marking native ActivityKit/wrapper/App Clip route as NOT IMPLEMENTED / ADR. Do not add a misleading simulated lock-screen UI.

Required regression tests/harness (headless/static where practical): focus start -> simulated background elapsed -> resume time correct; explicit pause excluded from elapsed; app switch does not pause/end lap/session; Hide roundtrip context stable; Snap roundtrip stable; offline event does not stop local timer; pageshow/BFCache restoration; stale return does not overwrite newer local session; task change closes only current lap; system wait separated from issue; active update does not auto-reload. Keep evidence honest: browser/iPhone physical lock-screen and cross-app behavior stays UNVERIFIED until device test.

Do not change main/prod/deploy/release, do not enable paid generation, do not add GPS/location, do not move Snap growth/badges/Wish Shop into Ready, and do not redesign Focus UI. Run bounded Node/static tests plus git diff check and report exact files/tests plus remaining real-device blockers.
